title: AI-first developer
description:
Vill du bygga AI som används på riktigt? På Sveaviken PM utmanar vi en traditionell bransch. Vi har flertalet egenutvecklade lösningar och söker nu en utvecklare som med hjälp av AI tar idéer till något som kollegor och hyresgäster använder varje dag. AI-driven utveckling är en självklar del av hur vi arbetar.
  
  

Om rollen Du bygger AI-lösningar, moderna plattformar, integrationer och API: er bland annat inom våra kärnflöden, som felanmälan och uthyrning, och jobbar nära kollegorna som använder dem. Du blir en del av ett IT- och digitaliseringsteam med kort väg till produktion. Du kommer bland annat att: Bygga AI-agenter och automationer som effektiviserar det dagliga arbetet. Utveckla integrationer mot våra system.
  
  

Bygga interna verktyg och webbappar för kollegor. Testa och kvalitetssäkra det du bygger. Vara en del av att driva bolagets AI-utveckling. Vem vi söker Vi bryr oss mer om vad du har byggt än om vilken utbildning eller titel du har.
  
  

**Vi söker dig som:** Har mycket god vana av AI-driven utveckling med verktyg som Cursor, Claude Code eller Codex. Har byggt spännande saker med LLM: er. Har några års erfarenhet av utveckling, i jobbet eller i egna projekt. Talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat.
  
  

**Det är ett stort plus om du har erfarenhet av:** MCP och skills. Att skapa och drifta öppna API: er. Fastighetssystem, ERP eller CRM. Vi bygger främst med TypeScript, React, Next.js, Supabase, Cloudflare och GitHub.
  
  

Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken, lär dig snabbt och hittar vägen från problem till fungerande lösning. Du driver gärna saker själv från idé till drift, trivs nära verksamheten och har omdöme om när AI är rätt lösning och när den inte är det. Hur vi arbetar Vi är team som rör sig snabbt. Du får stort eget ansvar och påverkar både vad vi bygger och hur.
  
  

Ser du ett bättre sätt att lösa något vill vi att du säger det. Hela vår miljö är molnbaserad och vi har inga gamla system att släpa på. Alla på bolaget använder AI, så det du bygger kommer till nytta direkt. Att jobba på Sveaviken PM Vi är ett bolag som växer snabbt, med korta beslutsvägar och plats för egna idéer och initiativ.
  
  

Hos oss är du med och formar nya tidens fastighetsförvaltning tillsammans med kollegor som vill samma sak. Tjänsten utgår från moderna lokaler intill Hammarby Sjöstad, vid Hammarbybacken 27 och huset Sthlm01 med närhet till kommunikationer. I huset hittar du flera restauranger och en takbar. Här har du även gratis tillgång till gym, cykelrum, dusch- och omklädningsmöjligheter.
  
  

Bra att veta Heltid, tillsvidare med sex månaders provanställning. Möjlighet till hybridarbete. Kollektivavtal via Fastigo. Tillträde i början av 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.
  
  

Skicka gärna med länkar till något du har byggt, till exempel på GitHub. Urval sker löpande.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
**Craft:**
 Technology & Development
   

  

**Job Description:**
 King operates games at a massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of players around the world. Behind every player experience is a large ecosystem of services, data platforms, forecasting systems, and internal tools that help our teams make better decisions, move faster, and deliver exceptional experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for a Developer (Python) to help design, build, and operate backend services, internal applications, and data-driven platforms that support critical business and product decisions across King. You will work on systems that process large volumes of data, run forecasting and analytical workloads, and provide reliable APIs and services consumed by teams across the company.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, analysts, product managers, and business stakeholders to build scalable solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights. This role combines backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud-native development, and data-intensive applications. While the primary focus of the role is backend engineering, you will also contribute to user-facing internal applications, helping deliver end-to-end solutions that enable teams across King to work more effectively.
   

  

 An important part of the role will be integrating our platforms and tools with the broader King and Microsoft ecosystem, enabling seamless collaboration,
   

  

 authentication, data exchange, and workflow automation across multiple services and platforms.
   

  

 King is a place where we build collaboratively and value diverse perspectives. We encourage experimentation, continuous learning, and ownership. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, solve challenging technical problems, and work alongside experienced engineers in a supportive environment.
   

  

 Your Role Within the Kingdom
   

  

 You will enjoy a creative, challenging, and collaborative environment where your ideas will be valued as much as your technical expertise.
   

  

 Some of your responsibilities include:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python
* Build scalable and reliable applications that support forecasting, analytics, and decision-making processes across the business
* Develop distributed processing pipelines and asynchronous workloads
* Design and optimize relational OLTP databases, data models, and query performance
* Build and maintain data processing, analytical, and forecasting workflows
* Design, develop, and maintain internal web applications when required
* Build intuitive interfaces and workflows that enable technical and non-technical users to interact with backend systems and business tools
* Integrate services with the King and Microsoft ecosystems, including identity, collaboration, communication, and productivity platforms
* Develop and maintain APIs and connectors that enable interoperability between internal and external systems
* Deploy, monitor, and operate containerized applications in cloud-native environments
* Contribute to technical designs, architectural discussions, and engineering best practices
* Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence
* Deliver high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing initiatives across teams
* Support CI/CD pipelines and automation practices throughout the software development lifecycle


 Skills to Create Thrills
   

  

 You are a software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building reliable systems that operate at scale. You are curious, pragmatic, and motivated by creating high-quality solutions that deliver measurable impact.
   

  

* Strong Python development experience in production environments
* Experience building backend services and APIs
* Understanding of modern web application development and the ability to contribute across the stack when needed
* Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, and distributed systems
* Experience designing and optimizing relational databases
* Experience building data-intensive applications and processing large datasets
* Experience with background processing, job orchestration, or distributed workloads
* Experience deploying and operating applications in containerized and cloud-native environments
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and automation pipelines
* Strong testing, debugging, and problem-solving skills
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
* High sense of code quality and the desire to build and maintain robust, reliable software
* Curiosity and adaptability when learning new technologies and domains


 Technologies We Use
   

  

 Our technology stack evolves over time, but currently includes:
   

  

* Python
* FastAPI
* Django
* HTMX
* TypeScript
* PostgreSQL
* Pandas
* NumPy
* SciPy
* Celery
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Drone CI


 Experience with all technologies is not required. We value strong engineering
   

  

 fundamentals and the ability to learn new tools and technologies as needed.
   

  

 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience building forecasting, optimization, simulation, or analytics platforms
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform or other major cloud providers
* Experience integrating with Microsoft technologies and services such as Microsoft
* Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, or related enterprise platforms
* Experience building internal developer platforms, business applications, or workflow automation solutions
* Experience working with large-scale data processing systems
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana or Sentry
* Experience improving application performance and scalability in production environments


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Backend Developer (TypeScript)
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for Backend Developers for several teams for our next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Backend Developer at Qred, you will take end-to-end ownership of some systems that power our financial products. You will bridge the gap between technical execution and business impact by building scalable infrastructure while actively contributing to our transition into an agentic-first fintech. This mission-driven role offers the autonomy to implement solutions using agentic AI. This will directly improve the experience of thousands of small businesses.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Build secure, scalable backend services and third-party integrations that align with our long-term architectural vision.
* Collaborate closely with other engineers to design efficient solution and their implementations.
* Deploy, test, and monitor production code while maintaining proper logging, tracing, and system health dashboards.
* Drive the implementation of AI frameworks and automated agents to shift our platform toward an agentic-first operating model.
* Mitigate technical risk by adhering to compliant engineering practices and acting with urgency on security alerts or production incidents.


 Our stack: AWS Serverless, Typescript, Node.js, Claude Code, Grafana, Github Actions.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We are seeking a structured professional who thrives in a collaborative, focused environment and avoids the trap of multitasking. You have the ability to drive alignment across teams, manage a disciplined workflow, and take proactive ownership of complex problem spaces. You are motivated by building scalable frameworks and establishing high engineering maturity within a fast-paced fintech ecosystem.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of professional experience in backend software engineering with Typescript.
* Strong knowledge of backend architecture, secure data transferring, and modern cloud environments.
* Practical exposure to using AI models, LLMs, or building automated agentic workflows.


 Why Qred?
   

  

 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work closely together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

 Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.
   

  

  

  

 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

title: Fullstackutvecklare sökes till Data & Analytics-teamet på Martin & Servera
description:
*Vi på Martin & Servera levererar mat och dryck till restauranger, kaféer och storkök över hela Sverige. Här är du med och driver utvecklingen i en tid då digitalisering och ny teknik öppnar upp nya dörrar för oss, våra kunder och hela restaurangbranschen. Du blir också en del av en varm och inkluderande kultur där vi jobbar tillsammans och har roligt ihop.*

 Martin & Servera är inne i en spännande digitaliseringsresa. Vår digitala transformation har stor strategisk bäring och vi satsar mycket på att erbjuda vår anställda de bästa verktygen för att optimera arbetssätt och affärsbeslut.
   

  

 Vill du driva utvecklingen av affärskritiska applikationer som optimerar prissättning och affärsbeslut? Vi söker nu en
 **Fullstackutvecklare**

* har flerårig högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller annan likvärdig utbildning.

* har goda kunskaper inom programmeringsspråken PHP, Python samt C#.

* är flexibel och har förmåga att arbeta i en föränderlig miljö med externa konsulter, anställda, IT och verksamhet på olika nivåer i organisationen.

 : För frågor om rollen kontakta: Annika Garneij Glans, annika.garneijglans@martinservera.se

 Anna-Lena Holsteryd, al.holsteryd@martinservera.se

 Tillsammans gör vi på Martin & Servera-gruppen skillnad för alla som älskar mat och dryck. Med omtanke om varandra, våra kunder och allas framtid gör vi varje dag lite godare. Och som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig del av framgången. På Martin & Servera växer vi och utvecklas tillsammans samtidigt som alla är viktiga och får ta plats. title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER TO SYSTEM EDSTRÖM

You'll work in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same and where your ideas, initiative, and passion for technology are highly valued.*
 YOU WILL

You'll help develop, improve, and maintain systems that support everything from sales and warehouse operations to management and strategic decision-making.
   

  

 The role is broad and varied. One day you may be customizing a customer portal, rebuilding test environments, or creating documentation for the sales organization. The next day you may be working with integrations, supporting internal users, or investigating new functionality that can improve products and business processes.

* Developing Web APIs and backend services
* Developing and managing integrations between business systems and platforms

 YOU ARE

title: Erfaren Backendutvecklare till Alecta
description:

 Som en av Europas största tjänstepensionsaktörer kombinerar vi tryggheten i en etablerad verksamhet med ambitionen att ständigt utvecklas. Hos oss får du arbeta med komplexa och affärskritiska system i en miljö där teknik, innovation och användarupplevelse står högt på agendan. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och lösningsorienterat team som tillsammans utvecklar framtidens digitala tjänster.
 



  





 Vi värnar om en hållbar balans mellan arbete och fritid och erbjuder generösa förmåner såsom friskvårdsbidrag, träningsmöjligheter, extra semesterdagar och lunchsubvention. Våra moderna lokaler ligger centralt i Stockholm och vi erbjuder goda möjligheter till hybridarbete samtidigt som vi värdesätter samarbete, gemenskap och kunskapsutbyte på plats.
 



  





 Alecta grundades 1917, ägs av sina kunder och är idag det femte största tjänstepensionsbolaget i Europa. Läs mer på www.alecta.se.
 



  





**Arbetsbeskrivning** 




 Som erfaren Backendutvecklare får du en central roll i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av de system och integrationer som stödjer Alectas verksamhet och bidrar till att säkerställa en stabil och effektiv hantering av tjänstepensionen för miljontals människor. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och teknik och ansvarar för att utveckla hållbara lösningar som kombinerar hög säkerhet, prestanda och användbarhet.
 



  





 Teamet ansvarar för de plattformar och integrationer som säkerställer att viktig kundkommunikation, dokumenthantering och informationsflöden fungerar säkert och effektivt för miljontals kunder.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
 


* Utveckla och förvalta backendlösningar, API och integrationer i en modern .NET-miljö
* Ta en aktiv roll i tekniska vägval, arkitekturfrågor och utvecklingen av framtidens integrations- och backendplattformar
* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till robusta och långsiktigt hållbara tekniska lösningar
* Arbeta med kvalitetssäkring genom automatiserade tester, CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsmetoder

title: Senior Platform & DevOps Engineer
description:
Auctionet is a marketplace where auction houses from Sweden, Great Britain, Finland, Spain, Germany, and Denmark sell furniture, art, design objects, collectibles, and much more. We are now looking for a Platform & DevOps Engineer who wants to build the infrastructure our engineers — and increasingly our AI agents — run on.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're expanding our Platform & Infrastructure team, and a good part of what you'd be part of creating doesn't exist yet.
   

  

 The foundation is familiar work: the infrastructure behind a marketplace used by over a million buyers, the pipelines our product teams ship through, and the developer experience that decides whether shipping feels easy or heavy.
   

  

 The new part is AI infrastructure. We're building internal tooling and automation with AI agents, and we need to decide how those agents are hosted, sandboxed, authenticated, and given controlled access to our data and our product. That means building real applications and APIs, not only configuring things. It's close to greenfield — you'd be part of shaping it rather than inheriting it.
   

  

 You'd be the third engineer in Platform & Infrastructure, alongside our Lead — who owns technical direction for the platform — and a senior engineer. Three people supporting a tech department of around 30, plus systems used well beyond Tech. That means you get real ownership early, and it means judgment about what to automate matters more than raw throughput.
   

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* Running and hardening our production infrastructure — reproducible from code, not hand-configured.
* Owning CI/CD and developer experience — making deploys frequent, boring, and reversible.
* Building the environments where our AI agents run: isolation, resource limits, scoped credentials, and audit trails.
* Building internal APIs and platform applications so agents, automations, and internal tools have a stable, documented, permissioned way into Auctionet's data and product.
* Enabling colleagues who build their own internal tooling with AI — paved paths and guardrails rather than gatekeeping.
* Owning observability across infrastructure, deploys, and agent runs, and keeping infrastructure and AI spend predictable.


 This role is based in Stockholm, hybrid (partly remote possible). Working language is English, and we'd like to start as soon as possible. On-call is voluntary and compensated.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join our Platform & Infrastructure team, working across every product team at Auctionet rather than inside one of them.
   

  

 We run our own Kubernetes on Hetzner, with additional infrastructure on AWS and an assortment of smaller services around the main stack. The platform carries around 1 million end customers, 80 auction house customers, and roughly 1,000 admins working in the auction house system every day — so this is real production traffic with real business hours behind it.
   

  

 Our product teams build in Ruby on Rails, with Turbo, Stimulus, and PostgreSQL. We also have systems built with Elixir and Phoenix. We care about how we build: maintainable code, solid test coverage, continuous deployment, and the kind of well-established best practices that keep a codebase healthy over years rather than months.
   

  

 Auctionet runs the leading online marketplace for European auction houses — art, design, furniture, and antiques. We have around 170 employees and are the parent company of a wider group with roughly 400 colleagues across multiple countries. Our main office is near Stureplan in central Stockholm, with logistics centres in Malmö, Stockholm, Gothenburg, Westbury, and Köln.
   

  

**About You**
 You like making other engineers faster, and you'd rather build a paved path than answer the same question twice.
   

  

**To succeed in this role, we think you have:**
* Solid infrastructure and operations experience, with infrastructure-as-code as your default rather than a project you keep meaning to start.
* Kubernetes experience with a genuine understanding of what's underneath it — we run our own clusters, so this isn't abstracted away.
* Real software engineering ability — you build and maintain applications and APIs, not only configuration. This role writes code.
* CI/CD and release engineering experience, and opinions about what makes deployment boring.
* A security instinct for running code you don't fully trust: sandboxing, least privilege, secrets handling, audit trails.
* Comfort working across teams as an internal service provider, and in English (Swedish is a plus).


**Bonus and not mandatory:**
* Hands-on experience running LLM agents or automation workloads in production.
* Experience across more than one cloud, or with self-hosted infrastructure on bare metal.
* Interest in art, design, or collectibles.


 You don't need to have done the AI part before. Nobody has been doing it for long. If you've built platforms for other engineers and you're curious about this, that's a strong start.
   

  

**Benefits**
* 30 days' paid vacation.
* Flexible holiday swap — trade two public holidays for ones you choose.
* 8% occupational pension — on top of your salary.
* Parental pay — a top-up to your paid parental leave.
* Wellness — a 4,000 SEK yearly grant, plus one paid hour a week during working hours.
* Health support — counselling, rehabilitation, and income support during long-term sick leave.
* Learning & development — an annual budget for courses, conferences, and professional growth.
* Art Club — events, exhibitions, and openings through our staff association.


 ... and a few more perks beyond these.
   

  

****How we hire****
 We see hiring as a two-way thing. We're mindful of your time, but we also want to spend enough of it together for both of us to get a real feel for working as a team — a short intro call, then two or three conversations with the team, and a small take-home exercise you can do in your own time. No whiteboard puzzles — we'd rather talk through real work together.
   

  

****Apply By****
 We will be reviewing applications continuously.
   

  

 If you're excited about this role but don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you. Very few people match every point — so if you're close and motivated, please apply.
   

  

****Who We Are****
 Auctionet was founded in 2011 by a team of people with unique experience of online auctions. Read more about Auctionet here.
   

  

 In 2021 Auctionet acquired the auction house Stockholms Auktionsverk, and we are now by far the largest auction marketplace in the Nordics, and one of the larger auction marketplaces in the world. With this acquisition, Auctionet owns and operates both the oldest auction house in the world (1674) and the second oldest (1681), which means we have been working with sustainability for 350(!) years.
   

  

 Join us in our vision to make valued objects accessible for everyone, from everywhere!

title: Senior Kafka Engineer
description:
**About Justera Group**
 Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a Senior Kafka Engineer to join an integration and platform engineering team responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving critical integration and messaging capabilities used by multiple development teams.
   

  

 The role focuses on Apache Kafka, HiveMQ, Kubernetes, platform stability, automation, self-service, security, and end-to-end operational ownership. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining highly available messaging platforms, automating operational processes, improving observability, and ensuring reliable and scalable platform performance.
   

  

 The position is primarily platform-focused rather than application-development focused, although you will collaborate closely with development teams and may contribute to customer projects when required.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design, deploy, operate, and maintain multi-cluster and multi-region Apache Kafka environments running on Kubernetes, using Strimzi Operator or similar technologies.
* Administer and maintain enterprise HiveMQ MQTT broker environments.
* Drive the upgrade lifecycle for Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ, including minor and major version upgrades and security patching.
* Coordinate platform patching activities to mitigate vulnerabilities while maintaining application availability.
* Develop and maintain custom Kafka Connect Source and Sink connectors for data integration between legacy systems and cloud environments.
* Define and implement Kafka scaling strategies, node affinity, topology spread constraints, and persistent volume configurations for I/O-intensive workloads.
* Manage Kafka broker partition layouts, topic configurations, compaction, retention, segmentation, and cluster-wide resource allocation.
* Design and implement high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover.
* Manage and enforce data governance using Schema Registry, including Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema.
* Design messaging traffic routing through ingress and edge technologies such as Envoy Gateway or custom proxies.
* Implement Kafka security controls including ACLs, SASL authentication, RBAC, OAuth/OIDC, and API management integrations.
* Implement and maintain security mechanisms such as mTLS, SSL/TLS, SASL/SCRAM, and certificate-based authentication.
* Build and maintain observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Fluent Bit, and/or OpenTelemetry.
* Create dashboards and monitoring solutions for key Kafka and infrastructure KPIs.
* Develop proactive alerting for issues such as Kubernetes node failures, JVM memory degradation, disk capacity thresholds, storage problems, consumer lag, and other cluster anomalies.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following platform incidents and implement preventive measures and automated guardrails.
* Provide Tier 3 support for complex Kafka and integration issues, including consumer lag, rebalance loops, performance issues, and network bottlenecks.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert for development teams working with Java and Spring Boot, advising on Kafka Producer/Consumer configurations, idempotency, acknowledgements, batching, schemas, and performance.
* Ensure platform stability, scalability, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build and maintain reusable GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for validating, testing, linting, and deploying infrastructure and Kafka-related configurations.
* Implement event-driven application scaling using technologies such as KEDA, based on Kafka lag and throughput metrics.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code principles using Helm, Terraform, and related tooling.
* Package and manage reusable Helm resources and OCI artifacts.
* Build developer self-service capabilities allowing teams to safely provision topics, schemas, credentials, and other messaging resources within defined architectural and security guardrails.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, READMEs, and operational procedures.
* Handle platform-level incident, problem, and change management.
* Collaborate closely with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, and Software Development teams.


**Requirements:**
 Kafka & Platform Engineering
   

  

* 4–6 years of experience with Apache Kafka at platform/engineering level.
* Strong experience with Kafka clusters, performance tuning, security, and administration.
* Experience with Strimzi Operator and Kafka on Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kafka Connect API.
* Knowledge of Kafka KRaft architecture.
* Experience with HiveMQ or enterprise MQTT platforms.
* Strong understanding of Kafka availability, replication, partitioning, retention, and scaling.


 Development
   

  

* 4–6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience developing or maintaining Kafka integrations and custom connectors.
* Experience with PostgreSQL.


 Cloud & Kubernetes
   

  

* Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Solid Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience working with Linux, including WSL.
* Experience with Azure and/or other major cloud platforms.


 DevOps & Automation
   

  

* Strong experience with GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins.
* Experience with ArgoCD and GitOps practices.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform or equivalent.
* Experience with Helm and OCI-based artifact management.
* Experience with automated deployment and platform lifecycle management.


 Observability
   

  

* Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
* Experience with Splunk.
* Knowledge of Fluent Bit and/or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience creating dashboards, alerts, and operational monitoring for production platforms.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with API Management (APIM) platforms.
* Experience across Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization and resource efficiency.
* Experience working within large enterprise integration or platform engineering departments.
* Experience with Envoy Gateway or similar edge-routing technologies.
* Experience with KEDA and event-driven autoscaling.
* Experience with OAuth/OIDC-based authentication and API security.


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Är du en DevOps Engineer med känsla för helhet, automation och moderna infrastrukturlösningar?
   

  

 Tillsammans med vår kund söker vi nu engagerade och drivna DevOps Engineers som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens plattformar. Här får du arbeta i en tekniktung miljö tillsammans med erfarna och kunniga kollegor, där du blir en del av ett kompetent DevOps-team med en central roll i att utveckla och förvalta plattformar som stöttar hela organisationens utvecklingsarbete. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med modern teknik, automatisering och ständiga förbättringar i en verksamhet där innovation och samarbete står i fokus.
   

  

****Om rollen:****
 Som DevOps Engineer tillhör du enheten för IT-drift och säkerhet, där du får en central roll i att förena drift, utveckling och infrastruktur. Teamet arbetar tätt ihop med applikationsdrift, systemförvaltning och arkitekter – där fokus ligger på hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och ett kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete.
   

  

 Du leder teamets arbete med att designa, bygga och förvalta standardiserade plattformar som maximerar automatisering och effektivitet. Rollen är både strategisk och operativ, och passar dig som trivs med ansvar, samarbete och teknisk fördjupning.
   

  

****Arbetsuppgifter:****
* Leda och koordinera DevOps-arbetet i teamet
* Automatisera och effektivisera existerande plattformar
* Övervaka, förbättra och säkra verktyg och miljöer
* Hantera och felsöka incidenter och komplexa tekniska problem
* Samverka med utveckling, arkitektur, drift och externa leverantörer


****Teknisk miljö:****
 Som DevOps Engineer kan du komma att arbeta med flera av följande tekniker och områden:
   

  

* Operativsystem: Linux och Windows Server
* Molnplattformar: Azure, AWS och/eller Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Containerteknik & orkestrering: Docker, Kubernetes och OpenShift
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi eller liknande verktyg
* CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins eller motsvarande
* Skript & programmering: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go eller andra relevanta språk
* Versionshantering: Git
* Övervakning & logghantering: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Splunk eller liknande
* Databaser: SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL eller andra databasteknologier
* Nätverk & infrastruktur: TCP/IP, DNS, lastbalansering och nätverkssäkerhet
* Säkerhet: Automatisering av säkerhetsprocesser, systemhärdning, identitetshantering och DevSecOps
* Arbetssätt: Automatisering, felsökning, incidenthantering, prestandaoptimering och kontinuerliga förbättringarVem vi söker:


 Vi söker dig som är trygg i en DevOps roll och van att ta ansvar – både tekniskt och i samarbete med kollegor och partners. Du är lösningsorienterad, nyfiken på ny teknik och har ett agilt tänk i ditt arbetssätt.
   

  

**Uppdraget kräver att du har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.**
****Varför söka den här rollen:****

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Nordics
description:
**About Telnyx**
*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a* 
*private, global, multi-cloud IP network* 
*, to bringing* 
*hyperlocal edge* 
*technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.*
*We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.*
*Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*
**The Role**
 We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod on the Nordics— one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.
   

  

 This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.
   

  

 You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
   

  

*The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE* 
 — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
   

  

*Forward Deployed Engineer* 
 — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
   

  

 We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
* Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
* Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Mistral Large, CroissantLLM, or other French/European sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
* Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
* Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
* Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
* Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
* Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
* Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, and Finnish language use cases and EU-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, data sovereignty, Nordic data protection laws)
* Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
* Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
* Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland
* Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams


**What We're Looking For**
* CS degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
* Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
* Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
* Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
* You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
* High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
* You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
* Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
* Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
* Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
* Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
* Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
* Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
* Based in Stockholm, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the Nordics (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland)
* Legally authorized to work in Stockholm


*Bonus Points For*
* Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
* Building eval sets for a specific domain
* Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
* Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including EU sovereign AI initiatives (Mistral, Aleph Alpha, Silo AI, Götalagsprojektet, and other European/Nordic model projects)
* Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
* SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
* ETL and data wrangling experience
* CI/CD pipeline design and automation
* Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
* Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and EU regulatory frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, French data sovereignty and SecNumCloud requirements, Nordic data protection laws, Schrems II implications)
* Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams to develop impactful analytics solutions, optimize code, and solve real-world business problems across diverse industries.
   

  

 You’ll grow as a technologist by contributing to cutting-edge projects, R&D, and global conferences while working alongside world-class talent in a dynamic, innovative environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with clients to understand their needs and develop impactful analytics solutions. You will translate business problems into analytical challenges, build models to solve them, and ensure they are evaluated with relevant metrics. You’ll also contribute to internal tools, participate in R&D projects, and have opportunities to attend and present at conferences like NIPS and ICML.
   

  

 Your work will create real-world impact. By identifying patterns in data and delivering innovative solutions, you will help clients maintain their competitive advantage and transform their day-to-day operations. Your contributions will directly influence business outcomes and drive lasting improvements across industries.
   

  

 You will be in Stockholm, and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world working on interdisciplinary projects that use math, statistics, and machine learning to derive insights from raw data. You will help global companies transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries such as healthcare, automotive, energy, and elite sports.
   

  

 At McKinsey, you’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll develop a sought-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, tackle real-life challenges across diverse industries, and collaborate with inspiring multidisciplinary teams, gaining a holistic understanding of AI and its potential to drive transformation.
   

  

 While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Bachelors, Masters or PhD level in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
* Professional experience in applying machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with copious amounts of data
* Programming experience (focus on machine learning): R and/or Python (must), SPSS, SAS, Ruby, Hadoop (valued)
* Ability to prototype statistical analysis and modeling algorithms and apply these algorithms for data driven solutions to problems in new domains
* Ability to independently own and drive model development, balancing demands and deadlines
* Demonstrated aptitude for analytics
* Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
* Good presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to people from other fields
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels
* Willingness to travel

title: Senior Security Engineer - Infrastructure
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

**Vill du bygga säkerheten bakom några av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster?**
 Vi söker en Senior Security Engineer - Infrastructure som vill stärka säkerhetsförmågan inom vår affärsenhet. Du arbetar nära plattformsteam, arkitekter och leveransorganisationer för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla tekniska säkerhetslösningar för våra plattformar och infrastrukturtjänster.
   

  

**Placering: Något av våra 30 kontor i Sverige**
 Hos oss bygger du säkerhet genom att utveckla tekniska lösningar, automatisera säkerhetskontroller och integrera säkerhet i våra plattformar från början. Våra plattformar används för att leverera digitala tjänster till samhällskritiska verksamheter, där säkerhet, tillgänglighet och robusthet är avgörande.
   

  

 Du får ett stort tekniskt ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både tekniska vägval och utvecklingen av affärsenhetens säkerhetsförmåga.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som Senior Security Engineer implementerar och vidareutvecklar du tekniska säkerhetslösningar för våra plattformar och infrastrukturtjänster. Du arbetar nära plattformsteam, arkitekter och utvecklingsteam för att integrera säkerhet genom hela plattformarnas livscykel.
   

  

 I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat att:
   

  

* Ge tekniskt stöd inom infrastruktursäkerhet till plattformsteam och leveransorganisationer.
* Designa, implementera och vidareutveckla tekniska säkerhetslösningar för våra plattformar.
* Äga och vidareutveckla säkerhetsverktyg och tekniska säkerhetslösningar.
* Automatisera säkerhetskontroller genom script, integrationer och interna verktyg, exempelvis i Python.
* Designa säker arkitektur för containerplattformar, moln och hybrida miljöer.
* Driva arbetet med säker konfiguration, sårbarhetshantering och teknisk riskreducering.
* Utvärdera, anpassa och använda AI-stödda verktyg för att effektivisera säkerhetsarbetet och utveckla nya arbetssätt.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av affärsenhetens säkerhetsprogram och säkerhetskultur.


 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Flerårig erfarenhet av Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security eller Security Engineering.
* Erfarenhet av att designa, implementera eller vidareutveckla säkra plattformar i moln-, legacy och hybridmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av Windows, Linux, Kubernetes och containerbaserade plattformar.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, automation och scripting, exempelvis i Python eller liknande språk.
* Erfarenhet av att implementera tekniska säkerhetslösningar i komplexa enterprise-miljöer.
* Intresse för AI-stödda verktyg och hur de kan användas för att effektivisera säkerhetsarbetet.
* God samarbetsförmåga och vana att arbeta nära plattformsteam, arkitekter och andra tekniska specialister.
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.


 På grund av rollens utformning är svenskt medborgarskap ett krav.
   

  

 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet av containerplattformar i större miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av publika eller privata molnplattformar.
* Erfarenhet av identitets- och åtkomsthantering (IAM).
* Erfarenhet av observability, logghantering och monitorering.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa enterprise-miljöer och samhällskritiska verksamheter.


 Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.
   

  

**Vad kan vi på CGI erbjuda dig?**
 CGIs kombination av global och lokal närvaro, med kontor på 30 orter i Sverige, ger nöjda kunder men innebär även att du som anställd alltid har ett kontor nära dig. Detta i kombination med flexibla arbetstider ger dig möjlighet till balans mellan privatliv och arbete, oavsett var i livet just du befinner dig.
   

  

 På CGI finns även stora möjligheter till interna karriärvägar där du kan välja att bli specialist inom ditt område, bredda dig inom nya områden eller ta en ledande befattning.
   

  

**Som anställd erbjuds du nedan förmåner:**
 ✅ Föräldralön: Vi betalar upp till cirka 90% av din lön under den första tiden hemma.
   

  

 ✅ Aktieprogram och delägarskap: Som delägare har du möjlighet att påverka och i vårt aktieprogram matchar CGI ditt bidrag, krona för krona upp till 3% av din månadslön.
   

  

 ✅Friskvårdsbidrag: Vi erbjuder ett årligt friskvårdsbidrag på 4000 kr.
   

  

 ✅ Trygg anställning: Våra medlemmar anställs med kollektivavtal och försäkringar.
   

  

 ✅ Pensionslösningar: Vi erbjuder attraktiva och förmånliga pensionslösningar.
   

  

 ✅Personalbil: Personalbilen används som en privatbil men leasas av CGI.

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: Test Fleet Engineer - Trucks
description:
### **Job description**


**About the role**

Would you like to combine technology, coordination and improvement work in a role where teamwork is important? We are now looking for a Test Fleet Engineer to join Sigma and work on an assignment with one of our customers in the automotive industry.


In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring high availability and efficient use of the customer’s test fleet. You will work closely with project management, test teams and workshops, coordinating activities throughout the full vehicle lifecycle. In case of unplanned stops, you will drive the work forward by securing workshop resources, materials, spare parts and transport when needed.


An important part of your daily work will be to drive continuous improvements. You will identify ways to improve working methods and processes and take the initiative to turn ideas into practical changes. Your ability to work with others and get people involved will be important – improvements are something we achieve together.


At Sigma, we offer you a role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact. You will have the stability and team spirit of being part of Sigma while working close to the technology and daily operations in a customer assignment.


**Your profile**

We are looking for someone with broad work experience and experience from several different roles. This has given you a good understanding of how different parts of an organization work together. Experience from the automotive industry, project management or technical coordination is an advantage.


As a person, you are positive, engaged and down-to-earth. You enjoy working with others, building good relationships and getting people involved. You see opportunities rather than problems and have the energy and persistence to drive change forward. Your attitude and ability to create engagement are just as important to us as your technical skills. Simply put, you are someone who puts the team first.


**Experience and qualifications**

* Around 5–10 years of experience working as an engineer, preferably within the automotive industry.
* Good technical understanding and an interest in vehicles and product development.
* Experience coordinating and driving activities from problem to solution.
* Experience with continuous improvement and a natural drive to improve ways of working.
* Good communication skills and fluency in spoken and written English.
* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Product Development, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a similar field.
  

  

**What can we offer?**  

As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to work across multiple areas with our clients – essentially the best part of being a consultant – but with the security of a single employer!  Through the acquisitions of 24translate, Hieronymus and Interlingua, we now operate across Sweden and the DACH region, and we are building a pan-European language solutions platform.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

**Leadership and strategy**
* Lead, coach and grow the IT Support team, and set clear priorities, service levels and ways of working
* Own the internal IT roadmap and budget, aligned with business growth and the CTO's technology strategy
* Act as the escalation point for complex or high-impact IT issues


**IT operations and support**
* Ensure reliable day-to-day IT support for all employees across Sweden and our European offices
* Own the full device lifecycle: procurement, setup, inventory, repair and secure disposal of laptops, phones and peripherals

* Administer our SaaS and collaboration stack (Microsoft 365)

**Integration and vendors**

**Behavioral Attributes We Value**

**Nice to have**

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
*We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company - you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.* 




  





*We’re looking for a Senior Security Engineer to join us in making the energy transition happen - maybe that’s you?* 




  





**Job Mission 🚀** 




 As a Senior Security Engineer, you'll play a key role in securing the platform that powers the energy transition for hundreds of thousands of homes. You'll be the technical backbone of our security posture - building controls, embedding security into how we build products, and making sure our engineers default to secure.
 



  





**What You'll Do ✅** 



* Secure the platform. Own the security posture of our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform - identity and access, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption, workload hardening, logging, alerting and detection. Build guardrails so secure is the default path for our engineers.



  




* Embed security in how we build products. Partner with product teams on threat modelling and secure design reviews. Run and tune code, dependency and container scanning through to remediation, and coordinate external penetration tests.



  




* Turn compliance into engineering. Implement the technical controls behind our ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2 and NIST CSF work, automate evidence collection, and translate requirements into backlog items engineers can act on.



  




* Raise the bar on corporate IT security. Strengthen the security configuration of our identity provider, endpoint management, SaaS integrations and office networks.



  




* Own incident response for the technical estate. Maintain and exercise runbooks, lead technical investigation and containment, and drive learnings back into the platform.



  




* Make the whole company better at security. Share knowledge, run workshops and champion a culture where security is everyone's concern and never a blocker for its own sake.



  





**What We're Looking For⚡** 




 You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:
 



  




* Have hands-on security engineering experience in a modern, cloud-native software company - and have seen what scale and growth do to a security posture.



  




* Are deeply comfortable in at least one major cloud (preferably AWS) and with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. You can read and write code and would rather automate a control than document a manual one.



  




* Know the practical security toolset - identity federation, secrets management, logging, vulnerability management and backup and recovery - and understand the trade-offs between options.



  




* Have translated frameworks like ISO 27001, NIS2 or SOC 2 into concrete technical controls and audit evidence, including running threat modelling with product teams.



  




* Are excited about how Tibber becomes more AI-enabled and embrace new tools and ways of working. You don't need to be an expert, but we believe you are motivated by that and excited to grow with it too.



  





**💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️The Tibber Mindset** 




*Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.* 




  





*We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!* 




  





*Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.* 




  





*You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.*

title: IT Säkerhetsarkitekt till Alecta
description:

 I rollen arbetar du nära både verksamhet och teknik och ansvarar för att säkerställa att våra IT-lösningar är säkra, robusta och anpassade för framtidens krav. Du får möjlighet att påverka på både strategisk och operativ nivå, från att ta fram arkitekturprinciper och säkerhetsriktlinjer till att stödja genomförandet av konkreta lösningar.  Som IT‑säkerhetsarkitekt har du en central roll i att stärka och vidareutveckla Alectas säkerhetsarkitektur. Du samarbetar nära verksamheten, utvecklingsteam och specialister för att säkerställa att våra lösningar uppfyller höga krav på säkerhet, stabilitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.
 



 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
 


* Definiera, utveckla och förvalta Alectas övergripande IT‑säkerhetsarkitektur utifrån verksamhetens behov och strategiska mål

 Vi söker dig som har en relevant utbildning, exempelvis inom datavetenskap eller systemvetenskap, eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.  Det är meriterande om du även har:
 


* Regelverk och standarder inom informations- och IT‑säkerhet, exempelvis ISO 27000, DORA, GDPR eller NIST CSF / SP 800‑53
* Identitets- och åtkomsthantering (IAM), inklusive moderna lösningar för identitetslivscykel och federation

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.**
 Stravito transforms how Consumer Insights professionals and Brand Managers work by building AI that automates their core workflows. We help world-leading organizations across industries accelerate strategic decision-making by turning millions of market research documents into intelligent systems that generate reports, discover insights proactively, and synthesize knowledge across vast content libraries.
   

  

 The data platform underneath makes all of this possible: ingesting millions of documents, enforcing tenant-level security, and feeding the AI systems our customers rely on daily.
   

  

****What Makes This Role Unique****
* Build the foundation: Own the data platform that powers AI products used daily by thousands of professionals at Fortune 500 companies
* Work with data that matters: Transform event streams, usage telemetry, and millions of proprietary market research documents into reliable, queryable intelligence
* Solve hard infrastructure problems: Design multi-tenant, secure-by-default pipelines and APIs that meet the compliance bar of the world's most demanding enterprise customers
* Own it end-to-end: This isn't a role where someone else defines the work. You'll scope work independently, dig into data quality issues, field requests from stakeholders, and drive things to completion.


****What You’ll Do****
 As part of the platform team, you'll own a broad area: from building infrastructure to supporting the teams that depend on it. In any given week you might:
   

  

* Build and operate data pipelines that move event streams, document metadata, and usage data into our cloud data warehouse (ClickHouse Cloud, Snowflake, Azure)
* Design and maintain APIs for analytics and event extraction, with multi-tenant security baked in (RBAC, OAuth, SSO/SAML)
* Make data usable: whether that's modeling schemas for BI consumers, investigating a data quality issue, or helping a stakeholder understand what's possible with the data we have
* Keep things reliable and secure through automated tests, monitoring, and handling of sensitive data within SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environments
* Power our AI experiences by working with vector stores, indexing, and retrieval systems
* Drive engineering best practices across the platform: CI/CD, peer reviews, infrastructure as code, API versioning, and clear documentation


****What We Need****
**Must-haves**
* A track record of building data platforms in SaaS or cloud-native analytics environments
* Strong programming skills, with depth in at least one of Python or Kotlin and willingness to work across both. Experience with Rust or TypeScript is a plus
* Hands-on experience with MPP/cloud data warehouses (e.g., ClickHouse, Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Azure Synapse) and cloud infrastructure on AWS or Azure
* Practical experience designing, consuming, and maintaining APIs
* Familiarity with multi-tenant security patterns: RBAC, row-level security, and identity standards such as OAuth and SAML/SSO
* Solid engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and infrastructure as code (Terraform a plus)
* Working knowledge of data privacy requirements (PII handling, GDPR) and experience operating within compliance frameworks like SOC 2 or ISO 27001


**Nice-to-haves**
* Experience integrating with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
* Familiarity with semantic search, embeddings, or vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector)
* Exposure to event-driven or streaming architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS)
* Experience with containerisation (Docker, ECS/Fargate)
* Interest in leveraging LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate data engineering work
* dbt, SQLMesh, or similar transformation framework experience


**This role is fully remote, but you will need to be a current resident for tax purposes in one of the chosen locations.**
*The salary range for this role depends on location and will proactively be shared with you in the first interview.*
**What’s in it for you?**
 Join a remote-first, globally distributed team of 100+ professionals from 30+ nationalities, united by our core values: simplicity first, an 'own it, do it' mentality, embracing different perspectives, and enjoying the journey together. We bring everyone together for company events throughout the year to strengthen our global connections.
   

  

 You'll grow alongside experienced colleagues with deep expertise across AI, market research, and enterprise systems. We offer exceptional career development opportunities in our fast-evolving market, competitive compensation, and a collaborative culture where everyone actively supports each other's success.
   

  

 Most importantly, you'll have the satisfaction of simplifying the professional lives of thousands of Brand Managers and Consumer Insights professionals worldwide, making their strategic decisions more data-driven and impactful.
   

  

 Ready to build the data platform behind Fortune 500 strategy? Join us.
   

  

 Stravito is the insights platform for the world's leading enterprises, right in the middle of an exciting transformation from a SaaS company into a world-class AI company. We bring all of a company's customer and market knowledge into one place, making it findable, usable, and ready to act on, so insights teams can make sharper, fact-based decisions. Founded in Stockholm, Sweden in 2017, Stravito today works with some of the world's most recognised brands and is home to 100 employees across 10 countries in Europe and North America.

 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att leda testarbete i SAP-relaterade miljöer. Du har erfarenhet av att planera, koordinera och följa upp testaktiviteter och med det en god förmåga att skapa struktur, tydlighet och framdrift i komplexa miljöer.
   

  

 Du är strukturerad, drivande och trygg i att koordinera andra. Rollen kräver att du kan arbeta på flera nivåer, från att bidra i strategiska frågor kring processer och riktlinjer till att vid behov kavla upp ärmarna och vara nära det praktiska testarbetet.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av testledning i SAP-projekt eller SAP-förvaltning.
* Förståelse för SAP-landskap, testmiljöer, transporter och releaseflöden.
* Erfarenhet av att planera, koordinera och följa upp testaktiviteter.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med både IT och verksamhet.
* Svenska i tal och skrift, eftersom rollen innebär nära kontakt med verksamheten och svenska är koncernspråk.


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har Erfarenhet Av**
* SAP Activate.
* SAP S/4HANA.
* SAP Cloud ALM.
* Testverktyg som Tricentis eller Worksoft.
* Retail, grossistverksamhet, logistik eller närliggande branscher.
* Att arbeta i större transformations- eller ERP-program.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet i denna rekrytering. Vi söker efter dig som trivs med att skapa ordning i komplexa sammanhang och som har förmåga att se helheten såväl som de detaljer som krävs för att testarbetet ska fungera i praktiken. Du är trygg i din roll som ledare och i att driva frågor framåt. Vidare är du prestigelös, samarbetsorienterad och har förmåga att bygga förtroende med både specialister och verksamhetsrepresentanter.
   

  

 Eftersom Martin & Servera bygger upp en starkare intern SAP-förmåga passar rollen dig som vill arbeta långsiktigt, ta ansvar och vara med och forma arbetssätt över tid.
   

  

**Placering och arbetssätt**
 Tjänsten är placerad på Martin & Serveras kontor på Lindhagensgatan i Stockholm. Arbetssättet är flexibelt, med möjlighet till hemarbete. Utgångspunkten är cirka tre dagar i veckan på kontoret, men dagarna är inte fasta och planeras utifrån teamets och verksamhetens behov.
   

  

**Anställning**
* Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, heltid.
* Placering: Lindhagensgatan 133, Stockholm.
* Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.


**Ansökan**
 I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Martin & Servera med Novare Tech. Skicka in din ansökan här.
   

  

 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
   

  

 För frågor om rollen eller processen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult på Novare Tech Henrik Dellgren, henrik.dellgren@novare.se eller Anna Jansson, anna.jansson@novare.se.
   

  

 Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kommer tester och bakgrundskontroll att genomföras. En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är grundläggande för Martin & Servera. Därför följer dom upp sin alkohol- och drogpolicy genom test under den inledande anställningsperioden och därefter genom kontinuerliga slumpmässiga tester på samtliga arbetsplatser.
